purpose: Exercise the comparison contract and portfolio decision process without authenticated provider execution.
assumptions: Each simulated condition is assumed to produce the already verified accepted implementation.
Provider-specific token, cost and elapsed-time values are unknown and must remain null.
No superiority claim may be derived when deterministic acceptance outcomes tie.

conclusion.structural: The benchmark/reporting contract can represent all three conditions without adding a model router or gateway.
conclusion.decision: Keep the fixed isolated four-stage team architecture as the canonical runtime because the simulation reveals no evidence that additional routing complexity is needed.
